raw_segments.text: Soothsayer, the fingers of the powers above dew-tune the harmony of this peace.
The vision which I made known to Lucius ere the stroke of yet this scarce gold battle,
at this instant is full accomplished.
For the Roman eagle, from south to west on wing soaring aloft, lessened herself, and
in the beams oh, T.H., sun so vanished.
Which foreshowed our princely eagle, T.H.
Imperial Caesar, should again unite his favor with the radiant Cymbeline, which shines here
